title: Weird Woman entity
content: So maybe this sounds weird but I was wondering if anyone else dreams about this? Almost 70% of my dreams consist of me running away and hiding or fighting this weird witchy entity. Sometimes she is in different forms but I somehow know that’s it’s the same woman. Sometimes I have other people or creatures that work for her searching for me. Sometimes I find her living in this huge tree with a bunch of tunnels. Even in my normal mall world dreams where I’m just doing my own thing I almost feel a weird presence watching me. She feels so real it’s very strange.
